scripts.bootstrap: npm ci && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv sync --project workers/science
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:workbench
scripts.db:info: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/dev/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm migrations info
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/dev/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm migrations migrate
scripts.db:validate: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/dev/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm migrations validate
scripts.dev: npm run build:server && concurrently --kill-others --names server,workbench "npm run dev --workspace @petra/server" "npm run dev --workspace @petra/workbench"
scripts.lint: eslint . && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project workers/science ruff check workers/science && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project workers/science ruff format --check workers/science
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc --noEmit --project packages/contracts/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/core/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/adapters/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/neo4j/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/postgres/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/retrieval/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/s3/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/server/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project experiments/m1-boundary/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @petra/workbench && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project workers/science mypy workers/science/src workers/science/tests
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:core && npm run test:adapters && npm run test:retrieval && npm run test:neo4j && npm run test:s3 && npm run test:server && npm run test:python
scripts.test:python: UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project workers/science pytest workers/science/tests
scripts.verify: npm run contracts:check-generated && npm run fixtures:check-generated && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:workbench && npm test
